source: Identity-preserving clothing edits of the original eight reaction atlases using the approved dressed v2 portrait.
preparation: Isolated sprites from the image generator atlases. Centered each cutout with transparent padding in a 1254 × 1254 RGBA PNG. Generated 512 × 512 WebP display files with alpha.

sheets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, a 3-column by 2-row landscape reaction atlas of exactly six distinct bust stickers. Image 2 is ONLY a garment and anatomical reference. Edit all six cells of Image 1 so this exact leaf-nosed bat Næsebladet wears the approved outfit in Image 2: rich dark plum velvet tailcoat with short high lapels and fine antique-gold piping, deep wine-russet brocade waistcoat with small brass buttons, soft ivory cravat secured by a tiny amber jewel, cuff edges where physically appropriate. Fit the outfit to each existing pose. Keep the same face, pointed pink leaf-shaped nose, russet cheeks, plum-brown fur, huge ears with a notch on the right side of the image, amber eyes, face angles and expressions. Keep the two organic umbrella-like wing membranes and their right and left wrists. Exactly TWO anatomical wing wrists with their tiny grasping hooks, physically attached to the wing membranes. No separate human arms, hands, fingers, feet or loose cuffs. Keep every existing prop/symbol, pose, gesture and its original placement in the same cell. Never copy Image 2's spoon into a scene unless Image 1 already has one. Keep the six-cell order and 3:2 aspect ratio. Clear generous isolation in each 512×512 invisible grid cell, with enough fully transparent gutter; no panel lines, text, grid, merged stickers, backdrop, shadow haze, or drop shadow. Everything outside each silhouette is truly transparent alpha, including the margins and gaps. Preserve painted fur and the mature warm detailed hand-painted editorial illustration style. Change only the garments.
Grid: Top-left slight wave beside two curved motion marks. Top-middle holding moss-green circular cream checkmark. Top-right thinking with wing claw under chin. Bottom-left listening beside two sound curves. Bottom-middle a warm glowing light bulb by one raised wing claw. Bottom-right looking up under muted teal question mark.

correction.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct only the anatomical duplication in this single approved clothed Næsebladet surprise reaction. Preserve his huge amber astonished eyes, open O mouth, large notched ears, leaf nose, plum velvet tailcoat and gold trim, red brocade vest, ivory cravat/amber clasp, paint texture, brown fur, and the entire current wide silhouette. This bat has exactly TWO total organic wing wrists with thumb hooks: the two claws located high at the two raised wing tips at left and right. Keep those two raised wrists with tiny cuffs. ERASE the two duplicate low claw/hand shapes next to the chest below the raised wrist tips. Replace them with unbroken smooth membranous wing finger seams trailing downward. The two wing membranes are proportionate continuous anatomical arms, no lower hands, no other cuffs, no fingers, no props, no feet. This is a seamless minimal correction, so no other parts should change. Centered square reaction sticker with generous transparent margins. True alpha fully clear outside the bat, no background or gradient, no lettering.
